title: Reaction Sticker Pack for Messaging
prompt_text: Create a 6-sticker reaction pack of [the person in the photo] showing 6 different exaggerated emotions: love (heart eyes), shock (jaw drop), laugh (tears of joy), thinking (chin rub), thumbs up, and goodbye wave. Each sticker is 512×512 px, transparent background, bold white die-cut outline 8px thick, kawaii chibi proportions, expressive cartoon style. Designed for Telegram/WhatsApp/iMessage.

title: Cute Animal Emoji Sticker Set
prompt_text: Create a sticker pack of 8 expressive cartoon animals: cat, dog, panda, fox, bunny, owl, hamster, and koala. Each animal in chibi style with oversized round eyes, soft pastel colors, simple bold linework, transparent background, white die-cut outline. 512×512 each, designed for messaging apps. Style: kawaii Japanese mascot aesthetic, friendly and emotive.

title: Holographic Iridescent Self Portrait Sticker
prompt_text: Transform [the person in the photo] into a glossy holographic sticker. Effect: iridescent rainbow gradient surface with chrome-like reflections, premium foil finish, light-catching highlights. Bold white die-cut outline 6px thick, transparent background. Style: vaporwave aesthetic, Y2K nostalgia, premium collectible feel. 1024×1024 square format.

title: Foil Glitter Star Letter Sticker
prompt_text: Create a single decorative letter sticker with the letter "[your initial]" in bold serif font. Surface: holographic foil with shifting rainbow gradient, surrounded by small glitter stars and sparkle accents. Transparent background, 4px white die-cut outline, 512×512 square. Style: premium scrapbook aesthetic, journal decoration, photo album craft.

title: Motivational Quote Sticker Pack
prompt_text: Create an Etsy-ready 12-sticker pack of motivational quotes: each sticker is a hand-lettered phrase like "You Got This", "Stay Wild", "Be Kind", "Make Today Count". Each sticker has a unique pastel color background with simple decorative element (flower / star / heart). White die-cut outline, transparent backgrounds, 1024×1024 each, designed for planner / journal / laptop decor. Commercial use ready.

title: Bullet Journal Productivity Sticker Set
prompt_text: Create a 16-sticker bullet journal productivity pack: checkbox icons, deadline flags, mood trackers, weather symbols, habit dots, priority arrows. Style: minimalist line art, soft sage green and beige palette, pastel highlights. Each sticker has a 4px white die-cut outline, transparent background, 256×256 each. Etsy-ready commercial use. Designed for daily planner overlay.
